memory_update.text: VRT should remain the reference anchor for data-center power and thermal infrastructure, but its high attention level makes it less useful for the underfollowed discovery lane.
MOD is a high-priority underfollowed thermal candidate because data-center cooling appears increasingly material and separable from legacy thermal/HVAC activities.
NVT is a plausible underfollowed electrical/thermal infrastructure candidate due to data-center enclosures, power distribution, liquid cooling, and acquired switchgear/bus-system exposure.
POWL is a chokepoint-style electrical balance-of-system candidate; the key risk is lumpy project concentration rather than structural recurring data-center exposure.

summary: Layer 1B expansion found one high-attention reference leader and three plausible underfollowed direct-exposure names tied to AI data-center power/cooling bottlenecks. Vertiv is the reference anchor for end-to-end power and thermal infrastructure. Modine, nVent, and Powell Industries are more Serenity-aligned underfollowed candidates because they sit in industrial/HVAC/electrical categories rather than obvious AI software or semiconductor screens, yet their disclosed product exposure maps directly to cooling, enclosures, bus systems, switchgear, and packaged electrical infrastructure.
